title: Which reaches the bottom fastest?
caption: Rolling from rest down 1.0 m, part of the energy goes into spinning: v = √(2gh / (1 + I/mR²)). The solid ball reaches 3.74 m s⁻¹; a hoop, with all its mass at the rim, only 3.13. A frictionless sliding block gets 4.43.
alt: Bar chart of speeds at the bottom of a 1 metre ramp: sliding block 4.43, solid sphere 3.74, solid cylinder 3.61, hoop 3.13 metres per second.
description: sliding block (I = 0 mR²): v = √(2 × 9.8 × 1 / 1) = 4.43 m s⁻¹.
solid cylinder (I = 0.5 mR²): v = √(2 × 9.8 × 1 / 1.5) = 3.61 m s⁻¹.
yLabel: speed at the bottom / m s⁻¹
